findings.text: New-plan readiness can be bypassed by removing every Acceptance marker, using punctuation-only markers, or supplying an empty task DAG.
findings.fix: Distinguish committed legacy plans from new plans and require meaningful Acceptance ownership and a non-empty task population for every new plan.

findings.text: A required combined spec and adversarial PASS is accepted when the reviewer is also recorded as the implementer.
findings.fix: For explicitly required pre-build review, require an independent fresh-context reviewer dispatch and reject self-review.

findings.text: Malformed or hostile Acceptance references raise an internal error instead of a controlled BLOCK.
findings.fix: Validate reference tokens and bounds before integer conversion.

findings.text: Punctuation-only positive or negative case identifiers are accepted.
findings.fix: Require each case identifier to contain at least one alphanumeric character.

findings.text: Runtime contract and lane guidance still describe after-task and wave-end formal reviews.
findings.fix: Align the manifest, scaffolded mirror, and lane-switch guidance with the single branch-end review design.

findings.text: The replay maps a published-verdict oracle to a stale mirror even though the canonical replay target already contains the fix.
findings.fix: Mark that oracle inapplicable rather than claiming the same root cause.

findings.text: W2-01 and W2-memory exceed the declared eight-file task cap.
findings.fix: Correct the plan ownership lists without changing delivered scope.

findings.text: The report presents a separate passing run as the cold-run result, omits the hook-trust and wcwidth blockers, and names tests that do not exist.
findings.fix: Rewrite the report from the recorded blind observations and use verified test names.

verdicts.notes: Focused branch-end probe suite: 8 failed and 102 passed at the reviewed SHA.

findings.text: New-plan readiness can be bypassed when all Acceptance markers are absent.
findings.fix: Make the readiness requirement default for new plans and narrow the legacy exemption.

findings.text: Non-numeric or huge Acceptance references can produce an internal error.
findings.fix: Return a controlled BLOCK for malformed references.

findings.text: A punctuation-only test identifier passes the non-empty check.
findings.fix: Require meaningful identifiers.

findings.text: The published independence rule does not reject an implementer acting as the required spec reviewer.
findings.fix: Enforce reviewer independence for explicitly required pre-build reviews.

findings.text: The published-verdict oracle is incorrectly mapped to the stale-mirror replay defect.
findings.fix: Record it as inapplicable to this fixture.

findings.text: Two tasks exceed the plan file-count cap.
findings.fix: Use accurate bounded ownership patterns or split the work.

findings.text: The mechanism evaluation points at a change-local evidence copy rather than the permanent package test.
findings.fix: Point the evaluation at the permanent review-reduction probe.

findings.text: The recorded checker-rule count and CHANGELOG mechanism claim are inconsistent with a one-for-one rule replacement.
findings.fix: Recompute the mechanism population and align the evidence and release note.

findings.text: The Claude invocation contract omits the tested CLI source/version and does not explain that verdict YAML is inside the JSON envelope result field.
findings.fix: Document the verified non-interactive invocation and extraction contract.

findings.text: Release probes became duplicates and the Ship word-count drift pin was removed.
findings.fix: Restore independently useful version agreement and current word-count checks without duplicating assertions.

findings.text: A clean README-style package setup lacks wcwidth, causing two package tests to fail.
findings.fix: Declare wcwidth in the development requirements and rerun from a clean environment.

verdicts.notes: Verdict was extracted from the JSON envelope result field after a no-tools Claude Code retry; earlier toolful attempts were nonconforming.
